cases.message: seed "myTicketsElsewhere": @namespace on a seed is retired -- memql#5375: a concept's namespace is its domain directory, or that directory's one-line namespace.pin
cases.note: memql#5426 found @namespace on a seed accepted and read by nothing: compileSeedDecl never copied the value, and a seed's concept resolves from its signature through the file's use imports. The attributes epic (memql#5375) retired it on every receiver rather than giving it an effect, before the language froze, so the parser refuses it by name with the rewrite that deletes it.
